scenario: Existing Lantern Reach Odell workshop roof head-bump after walking from its authored spawn
status: native interaction proof blocked after read-only eligibility review

publicRoute.method: Each walking step computes camera yaw atan2(targetX-currentX,targetZ-currentZ), then applies moveForward with near-target analog attenuation. No entity position rewrite occurs in this route.

nativeInputReview.gameBindings: WASD and Space are ordinary game inputs.
nativeInputReview.camera: Third-person orbit uses pointer drag; unchanged game initialYaw is Math.PI.
nativeInputReview.officialDriver: Key holds, clicks and fill are available; no ordered pointer-drag or analog-axis steering action was found.
nativeInputReview.detachedLook: Official --look requires an applied-aim handshake from the managed runner; the unchanged native GameHost does not provide it.
nativeInputReview.probe: Game capture config declares play only; no live movement probe. GamePlayerShell attaches __jgProbe only when playable.capture.probe exists.

priorLimits.observations: Previously inspected Lantern frames had texture decode failures, pale buildings and no visible local hero. The second movement sequence was excluded because of concurrent daemon targets.
priorLimits.meaning: No resolution of those native rendering blockers has been established by the new collision source change; this review does not assert a fresh observation of the latest package.

heightLimit.physicalSource: public DEFAULT_VOXEL_DIMS.height, same1.8 currently used by heightfield horizontal collision
heightLimit.consequence: Physical head clearance alone cannot establish that the taller displayed character clears the roof.

decision: Do not rerun the capped Lantern hero/appearance scenario or invent camera, spawn, readiness, document, probe or game setup mutations to make a head-bump capture. Preserve exact public-package collision evidence and leave native appearance/interaction unresolved.
